human_actions_autonomy_first_ai.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER human_actions_autonomy_first_ai AFTER INSERT ON human_actions
WHEN NEW.status = 'open'
  AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'autonomy_first_gate'), 'on') <> 'off'
  AND (SELECT gate FROM v_human_action_gate WHERE id = NEW.id) = 'fleet'
  AND COALESCE(NEW.source, '') <> 'owner-request-issue'
  AND COALESCE((SELECT approve FROM v_human_action_decision WHERE id = NEW.id), 0) = 0
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO autonomy_reroute_queue (human_action_id, title, description, category, priority)
  VALUES (NEW.id,
    'AUTONOMY-FIRST-REROUTE-1: ' || NEW.title,
    'AUTONOMY-FIRST-1 (migrations/2026-10-08-autonomy-first.sql): owner card #' || NEW.id || ' (' || COALESCE(NEW.slug, '') || ', from '
      || COALESCE(NEW.source, '?') || ') asked the owner for a decision that is not irreversible and identity-bound, so it is the fleet''s. '
      || 'Decide and execute: pick the best lever in the card''s action text (or a better one), apply it through the canonical path '
      || '(PR, migration, ops_config row), and close this issue with close_evidence naming the lever and a live measurement. '
      || 'Never re-open the card for the owner. Why: ' || COALESCE(NEW.why, '') || ' Default in effect: ' || COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect, '')
      || ' Card action: ' || COALESCE(NEW.action, '') || ' Charter pillar: autonomy.',
    'governance', CASE NEW.sev WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'critical' WHEN 'high' THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END);
  UPDATE human_actions SET status = 'rerouted', resolved_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now'),
    resolution = 'AUTONOMY-FIRST-1: queued for the fleet as an agent_issue (QUEUE-BREAK-CYCLE-1; drained by fleet_cron autonomy-reroute-drain)'
  WHERE id = NEW.id;
END

human_actions_default_adopt_ai.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER human_actions_default_adopt_ai AFTER INSERT ON human_actions
WHEN NEW.status='open' AND TRIM(COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect,''))<>''
  AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM ops_config WHERE key='default_adopt_gate'),'on')<>'off'
  AND COALESCE((SELECT approve + held FROM v_human_action_decision WHERE id = NEW.id), 0) = 0
BEGIN
  UPDATE human_actions SET status='resolved', resolved_at=datetime('now'), updated_at=datetime('now'),
    resolution='DEFAULT-ADOPTED-1: closed at birth on its stated default (owner directive 2026-10-12). Reopen with status=open.'
  WHERE id=NEW.id;
  INSERT INTO decision_log(actor,assumption,action,evidence,outcome,blast_radius,rollback_path,predicted_outcome,reach_gain,surfaces_tested,capability_gain)
  VALUES ('trigger:human_actions_default_adopt_ai','owner wants the waiting-on-you queue resolved autonomously','adopted stated default for card '||COALESCE(NEW.slug,'#'||NEW.id),COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect,''),'card closed, default in force','none beyond the default the card already named','UPDATE human_actions SET status=''open'' WHERE id='||NEW.id,
    'the card stays resolved on its stated default; if the step still matters its OWNER-STEPS-WATCH-1 probe or a refiled card brings it back within a day, otherwise nothing changes (DEFAULT-ADOPT-PREDICTION-1)',
    '0', 'human_actions.default_in_effect (the card''s own text), ops_config default_adopt_gate', 'none (removes a wait on the owner)');
END

human_actions_default_approve_ai.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER human_actions_default_approve_ai AFTER INSERT ON human_actions
WHEN NEW.status = 'open'
  AND COALESCE((SELECT approve FROM v_human_action_decision WHERE id = NEW.id), 0) = 1
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO autonomy_reroute_queue (human_action_id, title, description, category, priority)
  VALUES (NEW.id,
    'DEFAULT-APPROVE-1: ' || NEW.title,
    'DEFAULT-APPROVE-1 (migrations/2026-10-19-default-approve.sql; owner directive 2026-10-19: all decisions default approve, and a reversible fleet decision takes the recommended option and proceeds without waiting). '
      || 'Owner card #' || NEW.id || ' (' || COALESCE(NEW.slug, '') || ', from ' || COALESCE(NEW.source, '?') || ') is a decision the fleet takes. '
      || 'Doer: the loop or session that claims this issue (work-lock issue:<id>); a card whose action carries a code-task: line is built by the code loop. Execute the recommended option: the card''s Approve option, else its option (a), else the first option it lists; a card that lists no option is executed as the course its why recommends, else the lowest-risk reversible action, with the assumption stated in one line, through the canonical path (PR, migration, ops_config row). '
      || 'The default the card stated is superseded by the approve default and is not a reason to wait or to decline. Close this issue with close_evidence naming the change and a live measurement; never re-open the card for the owner. '
      || 'Still in force: the interrupt gate (IC-GATE-001), the harness permission checks, the shared-secrets lock and another session''s live claim; a step one of those refuses is stated with its reason and filed with a closing probe. '
      || 'Why: ' || COALESCE(NEW.why, '') || ' Default the card stated (superseded): ' || COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect, '(none)')
      || ' Card action: ' || COALESCE(NEW.action, '') || ' Charter pillar: autonomy.',
    'governance', CASE NEW.sev WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'critical' WHEN 'high' THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END);
  UPDATE human_actions SET status = 'rerouted', resolved_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now'),
    default_in_effect = 'APPROVE (DEFAULT-APPROVE-1, owner directive 2026-10-19): the recommended option is in force and the fleet executes it without waiting. The default this card stated was: ' || COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect, '(none)'),
    resolution = 'DEFAULT-APPROVE-1: queued for the fleet to execute the recommended option (autonomy_reroute_queue, drained by fleet_cron autonomy-reroute-drain); the stated default was not adopted. ops_config default_approve_gate = off restores DEFAULT-ADOPTED-1.'
  WHERE id = NEW.id;
  INSERT INTO decision_log(actor,assumption,action,evidence,outcome,blast_radius,rollback_path,predicted_outcome,reach_gain,surfaces_tested,capability_gain)
  VALUES ('trigger:human_actions_default_approve_ai','owner directive 2026-10-19: every reversible decision defaults to approve and takes the recommended option without waiting','queued the recommended option of card '||COALESCE(NEW.slug,'#'||NEW.id)||' for the fleet instead of closing it on its stated default',COALESCE(NEW.default_in_effect,'(no default stated)'),'card rerouted, approve default in force','the recommended option of one reversible decision, executed by the fleet through the canonical path','ops_config default_approve_gate = off; UPDATE human_actions SET status=''open'' WHERE id='||NEW.id,
    'the autonomy-reroute-drain task files an agent_issues row for this card within 10 minutes and the fleet executes the recommended option; if the issue is still open after 120 minutes the stuck views name it (DEFAULT-APPROVE-1)',
    '0', 'human_actions card text, v_human_action_decision, ops_config default_approve_gate', 'decisions take the recommended option without a wait on the owner');
END

agent_issues_autotriage2_ins.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_autotriage2_ins AFTER INSERT ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.status = 'open'
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO issue_triage (issue_id, rc, triage_state, owner, sla_due_at)
  SELECT NEW.id,
         CASE WHEN o.owner IS NULL THEN 'AUTOTRIAGE-1' ELSE 'AUTOTRIAGE-2' END,
         'triaged',
         COALESCE(o.owner, 'qnfo-ops'),
         datetime('now', '+120 minutes')
    FROM (SELECT COALESCE(
            (SELECT t.owner FROM analytics_metric_triggers t
              WHERE NEW.title LIKE 'METRIC-TRIGGER-%'
                AND t.id = CAST(substr(NEW.title, 16) AS INTEGER)
                AND t.owner IN (SELECT service FROM service_registry)),
            (SELECT s.service FROM service_registry s
              WHERE instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=') > 0
                AND s.service = substr(substr(NEW.description, instr(NEW.description, 'code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=') + 34), 1,
                                       instr(substr(NEW.description, instr(NEW.description, 'code-task: repo=qnfo-workers path=') + 34), '/') - 1))
          ) AS owner) o;
END

CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_code_probe_upd AFTER UPDATE OF description ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.status = 'open' AND instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') > 0
  AND (instr(COALESCE(OLD.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') = 0 OR substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {'), instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {')), '}')) IS NOT substr(COALESCE(OLD.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(OLD.description, ''), 'code-probe: {'), instr(substr(COALESCE(OLD.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(OLD.description, ''), 'code-probe: {')), '}')))
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO remediation_contracts (class, issue_id, precondition, action, verify_probe, verify_transport, max_attempts, escalate_to, expected_cadence_h, status, module)
  VALUES ('issue-' || NEW.id, NEW.id, 'code-probe line in the issue (PROBE-BIRTH-2)', 'needs-machine-probe', 'needs-machine-probe', 'd1-query', 3, 'qnfo-fleet-control', 6, 'needs-machine-probe', 'birth');
  UPDATE remediation_contracts
  SET verify_transport = 'code-read', verify_probe = substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}')),
      status = 'active', module = 'code-probe-line-v1', attempts = 0, last_verdict = NULL, next_due_at = datetime('now'),
      expected_cadence_h = 6, max_attempts = 3,
      precondition = 'code-probe line in the issue (PROBE-BIRTH-2)',
      action = 'the doer changes the code on main; scripts/remediation_consumer.py reads its checkout of main and a pass closes the issue'
  WHERE class = 'issue-' || NEW.id
    AND NOT (verify_transport = 'code-read' AND status = 'active' AND verify_probe = substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}')))
    AND json_valid(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}'))) AND json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}')), '$.paths') = 'array' AND (json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}')), '$.contains') = 'text' OR json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'code-probe: {') + 12), '}')), '$.absent') = 'text');
END

agent_issues_evidence_annotate_ai.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_evidence_annotate_ai AFTER INSERT ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.source LIKE 'cloud_ops_events:%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events e WHERE e.id = replace(NEW.source, 'cloud_ops_events:', ''))
BEGIN
  UPDATE agent_issues SET description = COALESCE(description, '') || char(10) || 'NO-SILENT-DROP-1: the cited evidence event ' || NEW.source || ' does not exist; the issue was kept and needs its evidence re-attached.'

agent_issues_open_dup_annotate.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_open_dup_annotate BEFORE INSERT ON agent_issues
WHEN COALESCE(NEW.status, 'open') = 'open'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues x WHERE x.status = 'open' AND lower(trim(x.title)) = lower(trim(NEW.title)))
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_issue_refiles (issue_id, refiles, first_at)
    SELECT x.id, 0, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM agent_issues x
    WHERE x.status = 'open' AND lower(trim(x.title)) = lower(trim(NEW.title)) ORDER BY x.id LIMIT 1;
  UPDATE agent_issue_refiles SET refiles = refiles + 1, last_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
    last_source = substr(COALESCE(NEW.source, '?'), 1, 200)
  WHERE issue_id = (SELECT x.id FROM agent_issues x WHERE x.status = 'open' AND lower(trim(x.title)) = lower(trim(NEW.title))
                    ORDER BY x.id LIMIT 1);
  SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END

CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_reopen_open_twin_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.status = 'open'
  AND COALESCE(OLD.status, '') <> 'open'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues o
               WHERE o.id <> NEW.id
                 AND o.status = 'open'
                 AND lower(trim(o.title)) = lower(trim(NEW.title)))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END

  SET verify_transport = 'runner-https', verify_probe = substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')),
      status = 'active', module = 'runtime-probe-line-v2', attempts = 0, last_verdict = NULL, next_due_at = datetime('now'),
      expected_cadence_h = 6, max_attempts = 3,
      precondition = 'runtime-probe line in the issue (PROBE-BIRTH-2)',
      action = 'the doer fixes the live behaviour; scripts/remediation_consumer.py GETs it from the GitHub runner and a pass closes the issue'
  WHERE class = 'issue-' || NEW.id
    AND NOT (verify_transport = 'runner-https' AND status = 'active' AND verify_probe = substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')))
    AND json_valid(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}'))) AND json_extract(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')), '$.url') LIKE 'https://%' AND (json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')), '$.contains') = 'text' OR json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')), '$.absent') = 'text' OR json_type(substr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), 1, instr(substr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), instr(COALESCE(NEW.description, ''), 'runtime-probe: {') + 15), '}')), '$.status') = 'integer');
END

agent_issues_ts_norm_ins.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER agent_issues_ts_norm_ins AFTER INSERT ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.created_at IS NULL OR typeof(NEW.created_at)='text'
  OR (typeof(NEW.created_at)='integer' AND NEW.created_at > 0 AND NEW.created_at < 100000000000)
  OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL OR typeof(NEW.updated_at)='text'
  OR (typeof(NEW.updated_at)='integer' AND NEW.updated_at > 0 AND NEW.updated_at < 100000000000)
BEGIN
  UPDATE agent_issues SET
    created_at = CASE
      WHEN NEW.created_at IS NULL THEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000
      WHEN typeof(NEW.created_at)='text' THEN COALESCE(CAST(strftime('%s', NEW.created_at) AS INTEGER)*1000, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000)
      WHEN NEW.created_at > 0 AND NEW.created_at < 100000000000 THEN NEW.created_at*1000
      ELSE NEW.created_at END,
    updated_at = CASE
      WHEN NEW.updated_at IS NULL THEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000
      WHEN typeof(NEW.updated_at)='text' THEN COALESCE(CAST(strftime('%s', NEW.updated_at) AS INTEGER)*1000, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000)
      WHEN NEW.updated_at > 0 AND NEW.updated_at < 100000000000 THEN NEW.updated_at*1000
      ELSE NEW.updated_at END
  WHERE id = NEW.id;
END

decision_predictions_parse.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER decision_predictions_parse AFTER INSERT ON decision_log
WHEN instr(COALESCE(NEW.predicted_outcome, ''), ' within ') > 0
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO decision_predictions (decision_id, kind, subject, op, value, due_at, origin)
    SELECT NEW.id, 'metric', t.tok1, t.tok2, CAST(t.tok3 AS REAL),
      strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '+' || CAST(t.after AS INTEGER) || CASE WHEN instr(t.after, ' d') > 0 THEN ' days' ELSE ' hours' END), 'parsed'
    FROM (
      SELECT u.tok1, u.tok2,
        CASE WHEN instr(u.rest2, ' ') > 0 THEN substr(u.rest2, 1, instr(u.rest2, ' ') - 1) ELSE u.rest2 END AS tok3, u.after
      FROM (
        SELECT v.tok1,
          CASE WHEN instr(v.rest1, ' ') > 0 THEN substr(v.rest1, 1, instr(v.rest1, ' ') - 1) ELSE v.rest1 END AS tok2,
          CASE WHEN instr(v.rest1, ' ') > 0 THEN ltrim(substr(v.rest1, instr(v.rest1, ' ') + 1)) ELSE '' END AS rest2, v.after
        FROM (
          SELECT substr(w.p, 1, instr(w.p, ' ') - 1) AS tok1, ltrim(substr(w.p, instr(w.p, ' ') + 1)) AS rest1,
            ltrim(substr(w.p, instr(w.p, ' within ') + 8)) AS after
          FROM (SELECT trim(NEW.predicted_outcome) AS p) w
        ) v
      ) u
    ) t
    WHERE t.tok1 IN (SELECT metric FROM metric_registry) AND t.tok2 IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=', '=')
      AND t.tok3 GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(t.after AS INTEGER) > 0;
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO decision_predictions (decision_id, kind, subject, op, value, due_at, origin)
    SELECT NEW.id, 'issue', CAST(CAST(substr(w.p, 7) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT), 'closed', NULL,
      strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '+' || CAST(w.after AS INTEGER) || CASE WHEN instr(w.after, ' d') > 0 THEN ' days' ELSE ' hours' END), 'parsed'
    FROM (SELECT trim(NEW.predicted_outcome) AS p, ltrim(substr(trim(NEW.predicted_outcome), instr(trim(NEW.predicted_outcome), ' within ') + 8)) AS after) w
    WHERE lower(substr(w.p, 1, 6)) = 'issue ' AND CAST(substr(w.p, 7) AS INTEGER) > 0
      AND instr(lower(w.p), ' closed within ') > 0 AND CAST(w.after AS INTEGER) > 0;
END

issue_close_evidence_required.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER issue_close_evidence_required
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON agent_issues
WHEN NEW.status IN ('closed','resolved','wontfix') AND OLD.status NOT IN ('closed','resolved','wontfix')
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'close-without-evidence')
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_triage t WHERE t.issue_id = NEW.id AND t.close_evidence IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.close_evidence) <> '');
  -- CLOSE-BINDS-TO-PROBE-1 (2026-10-18): a claim that the defect is GONE must agree with the fleet's own probe.
  -- wontfix is deliberately exempt: declining to fix is a decision, not a claim of resolution.
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'close-while-contract-fails')
    WHERE NEW.status IN ('closed','resolved')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remediation_contracts c WHERE c.issue_id = NEW.id
                    AND c.status IN ('active','holding')
                    AND COALESCE(c.last_verdict,'') IN ('fail','vacuous-probe-result','probe-error','probe-not-machine-executable','probe-same-account-host'));
END

CREATE TRIGGER issue_refile_reopen BEFORE INSERT ON agent_issues
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues t WHERE t.title = NEW.title AND t.status IN ('resolved', 'wontfix', 'closed')
  AND typeof(t.updated_at) = 'integer' AND t.updated_at > (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000 - 86400000))
BEGIN
  UPDATE agent_issues SET status = 'open', updated_at = CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000,
      description = COALESCE(description, '') || char(10) || 'REOPENED ' || strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') || ' by issue_refile_reopen (DOCTRINE-1): the same title was filed again within 24 h of the close, by ' || COALESCE(NEW.source, '?') || '.'
  WHERE id = (SELECT t.id FROM agent_issues t WHERE t.title = NEW.title AND t.status IN ('resolved', 'wontfix', 'closed')
    AND typeof(t.updated_at) = 'integer' AND t.updated_at > (strftime('%s', 'now') * 1000 - 86400000) ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1);
  SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END
